title: The Locked Office
answer: A, the assistant. She said she was on the phone with Mr. Cole until 9:30, but his phone shows his last call ended at 7:12 PM.

beats.line: Mr. Cole was found dead in his locked office. Three people say they couldn't have done it. One is lying.
Late at night, on the top floor of Cole Tower.
The assistant says she was on the phone with Mr. Cole until 9:30, and he sounded fine.

visual.name: The Assistant
visual.alibi: On the phone with him till 9:30.

beats.line: The cousin says he was waiting in the lobby from nine.
The doctor says she was on a video call with a patient all evening.

visual.name: The Doctor
visual.alibi: On a video call all evening.

beats.line: Clue one: the lobby log. The cousin signed in at 9:02.
Clue two: the doctor's laptop. A video call from eight to 10:30.
Clue three: Mr. Cole's own phone. His last call ended at 7:12.
Only one alibi doesn't add up. Who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
